edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from argument of _transfer via the public transfer entrypoint.
from parameter drives zero-address, blacklist and pair checks in _transfer.
to parameter drives zero-address and cooldown logic in _transfer.
amount parameter is validated against _maxTxAmount and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
cooldown mapping is read to enforce the per-recipient anti-bot delay.
block.timestamp is compared with cooldown[to], creating timestamp dependency.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] = block.timestamp + 60 seconds.
_maxTxAmount is read to bound transfer size from the pair.
bots mapping gates transfers for non-owner participants.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether fees and swaps are applied.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to select fee and swap paths.
swapEnabled gates the automatic token-to-ETH swap branch.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown enforcement branch.
contractTokenBalance is computed then used as the swap amount.
contractETHBalance decides whether sendETHToFee is invoked.
balanceOf(address(this)) is assigned into contractTokenBalance.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth before completing the token accounting.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee, moving ETH out during a transfer.
_transfer delegates accounting to _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the external swap call.
tokenAmount parameter is forwarded as amountIn to the router swap.
the local path array is passed as the swap route.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
sendETHToFee executes native ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
half of the ETH is transferred to _feeAddrWallet1.
half of the ETH is transferred to _feeAddrWallet2.
sendETHToFee divides the amount by two using SafeMath.
_transfer relies on SafeMath sub/add for balance updates.
_transferStandard uses SafeMath sub/add on reflection balances and fee totals.
_transferStandard writes updated reflection balances into _rOwned.
_transferStandard reads current _rOwned values before subtracting and adding.
onlyOwner on openTrading compares _owner with the caller.
msg.sender is checked by the onlyOwner modifier on openTrading.
openTrading forwards contract ETH through addLiquidityETH.
openTrading stores the newly created pair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading stores the router instance into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading performs an unlimited approve on the pair.
openTrading flips tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables automatic swaps.
openTrading enables the cooldown mechanism.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to the launch cap.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity and swap deadline.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the required caller of manualswap and can pull contract tokens.
manualswap invokes the external swap routine on the whole contract balance.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with _feeAddrWallet1.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the required caller of manualsend and drains contract ETH.
manualsend forwards the whole contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
onlyOwner on setBots restricts blacklisting to the owner.
onlyOwner on delBot restricts blacklist removal to the owner.
onlyOwner on setCooldownEnabled restricts the cooldown toggle.
onlyOwner on renounceOwnership restricts ownership renouncement.
msg.sender is validated by the onlyOwner modifier on setBots.
msg.sender is validated by the onlyOwner modifier on delBot.
msg.sender is validated by the onlyOwner modifier on setCooldownEnabled.
msg.sender is validated by the onlyOwner modifier on renounceOwnership.
bots_ array elements are written into the bots blacklist mapping.
notbot is written into the bots mapping as false.
onoff is assigned to cooldownEnabled.
sender parameter is forwarded to _transfer in transferFrom.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer in transferFrom.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer and subtracted from allowance.
transferFrom calls _transfer with the caller-supplied sender and recipient.
transfer calls _transfer with _msgSender() as the sender.
msg.sender becomes the from address inside transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender when updating allowances in transferFrom.
amount parameter is split between the two fee wallets.
tAmount is decomposed into fee components by _transferStandard.
currentRate multiplies the team fee inside _takeTeam.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute reflection amounts.
_getValues returns rAmount, rTransferAmount, rFee and token fees to _transferStandard.
setBots mutates the bots state mapping.
delBot mutates the bots state mapping.
ETH sent to fee wallets can re-enter the contract, and receive() allows the fallback path.
the router swap can call back into the token during the external call.

normalization_plan.reason: The token amount is only forwarded to the router swap call.
The swap path array is built and consumed entirely inside swapTokensForEth.
The amount argument is only split and forwarded to the fee wallets.
The array argument is only iterated to update the bots mapping.
The single address argument is only used to clear a blacklist entry.
The boolean argument is only assigned to cooldownEnabled.
The sender argument is only forwarded to _transfer within transferFrom.
The recipient argument is only forwarded to _transfer within transferFrom.
The amount argument is only forwarded to _transfer and the allowance subtraction.
The token amount is only decomposed into reflection and fee values.
The rate is read and multiplied inside _takeTeam before crediting the contract.
